base_rates.note: In-sample and on today's list of survivors: names that did well enough to be on the list today, so this flatters the checklist. Samples every 20 trading days do not overlap in time for one name, but names move together, so the real uncertainty is wider than the 90% ranges shown.

forward.note: Forward only: every 20 trading days each name's verdict is written with that day's data and never edited; each is scored 20 trading days later as its excess return over the benchmark.
